facts.summary: Singapore patent granted for REQORSA plus anti-PD-1 combination · Phase 1/2 · Reqorsa in extensive stage small cell lung cancer · not yet approved
facts.indication: extensive stage small cell lung cancer

evidence.summary: the Singapore Patent Office has granted a patent to Genprex that covers the use of the Company’s lead drug candidate, Reqorsa® (quaratusugene ozeplasmid) Gene Therapy, in combination with anti-PD-1 antibodies through 2037.
